cues.en: Instructor: Now, I'm going to tell you about a method for computing confidence intervals via what's called bootstrapping, also sometimes called resampling data.
cues.zh: 講師：現在要介紹透過拔靴法，也有時稱為資料重抽樣，來計算信賴區間的方法。

cues.en: And you'll see why it's called resampling when I explain the procedure.
cues.zh: 等我說明流程之後，你就會明白為什麼叫作重抽樣。

cues.en: So then, after telling you how this works, I will talk about the differences between the parametric and non-parametric confidence intervals, parametric being applying the formula
cues.zh: 介紹運作方式之後，我會討論參數與無母數信賴區間的差異。參數方法就是套用

cues.en: that I showed a few slides ago, and non-parametric being the bootstrapping method that you will learn here.
cues.zh: 幾張投影片之前介紹的公式，無母數方法則是你在這裡將學到的拔靴法。

cues.en: Okay, so here is the idea of bootstrapping confidence intervals.
cues.zh: 好，以下就是拔靴法信賴區間的概念。

cues.en: Instead of using a formula, these formulas are always based on particular assumptions and it's, you know, questionable whether those assumptions are met in some data sets.
cues.zh: 我們不使用公式。公式總是基於特定假設，而有些資料集是否符合那些假設，是值得懷疑的。

cues.en: Sometimes they are, sometimes they're not.
cues.zh: 有時符合，有時不符合。

cues.en: So instead, we compute the confidence intervals directly based on the data that we've already measured.
cues.zh: 因此，我們改成直接根據已經量測到的資料計算信賴區間。

cues.en: And the way that we do this is by repeatedly and randomly sampling from our dataset.
cues.zh: 方法是反覆從資料集中隨機抽樣。

cues.en: So it's kind of like we are thinking about our sample as the entire population, and then we are sampling from that population, which is really just a sample.
cues.zh: 有點像把我們的樣本視為整個母體，再從這個其實只是樣本的母體中抽樣。

cues.en: So that's why it's called resampling.
cues.zh: 所以才叫作重抽樣。

cues.en: So here's the basic idea.
cues.zh: 基本概念如下。

cues.en: Let's imagine you have 10 data points.
cues.zh: 假設你有 10 個資料點。

cues.en: So, I call these X1 through X10. This is 10 data points.
cues.zh: 我把它們稱為 X1 到 X10，共有 10 個資料點。

cues.en: Of course, in practice it's good to have more than 10 data points, but you know, this is just an illustration.
cues.zh: 實際上，資料點超過 10 個當然比較好，不過這只是示意。

cues.en: So now what we do is something called resampling with replacement.
cues.zh: 接著進行所謂的放回重抽樣。

cues.en: What does this mean with replacement?
cues.zh: 放回是什麼意思？

cues.en: So it means that we have this sample and we just randomly pick one of these numbers.
cues.zh: 意思是我們有這份樣本，從這些數字中隨機挑一個。

cues.en: So maybe it's X3.
cues.zh: 例如 X3。

cues.en: So we randomly pick X3.
cues.zh: 我們隨機選到 X3。

cues.en: And then we write down the number, the value of X3, and then we put X3 back into the pile.
cues.zh: 記下 X3 的數值，再把 X3 放回原來那堆資料。

cues.en: So X3 goes back in here.
cues.zh: X3 就放回這裡。

cues.en: And then we randomly pick again.
cues.zh: 接著再次隨機抽取。

cues.en: So it can actually happen that we pick X3 twice, we can randomly sample again and get X3.
cues.zh: 所以我們確實可能抽到 X3 兩次；再次隨機抽樣時，又抽到 X3。

cues.en: And also, from doing a bunch of random replacements, we might never get X6, that can happen.
cues.zh: 反覆進行這樣的隨機放回抽樣，也可能一次都沒抽到 X6。

cues.en: So here's one example.
cues.zh: 以下是一個例子。

cues.en: This is resampled with replacement from this list of 10.
cues.zh: 這是從這份含 10 筆資料的清單中放回重抽樣的結果。

cues.en: Now notice, first of all, that I have the same number of numbers.
cues.zh: 首先注意，數字的數量一樣。

cues.en: So our original sample is 10, we have 10 data points, and the resampled or bootstrapped dataset also has 10 data points, but there are some repetitions here.
cues.zh: 原始樣本有 10 個資料點，重抽樣或拔靴法資料集也有 10 個資料點，但其中有些重複。

cues.en: So we have six twice.
cues.zh: 6 出現兩次。

cues.en: Let's see, eight appears twice, one appears twice.
cues.zh: 看看，8 出現兩次，1 也出現兩次。

cues.en: And it looks like we're missing four, we're missing five.
cues.zh: 看來少了 4，也少了 5。

cues.en: So this is not exactly the same data just shuffled, it's resampled with replacement.
cues.zh: 因此，這不是把同一份資料打亂順序，而是放回重抽樣。

cues.en: Okay, so we do this and we record the mean, and then we do it again and we record the mean.
cues.zh: 好，我們這樣抽一次，記錄平均值；再抽一次，再記錄平均值。

cues.en: And you can probably guess where this is going.
cues.zh: 你應該猜得到接下來要做什麼。

cues.en: We repeat this a bunch of times, maybe you repeat it 500 times or 1,000 times, you repeat it lots and lots of times.
cues.zh: 我們重複很多次，例如 500 次或 1,000 次，重複非常多次。

cues.en: You get hundreds of different sample datasets that are all based on resampling with replacement from the original dataset.
cues.zh: 你會得到數百份不同的樣本資料集，全部都是從原始資料集放回重抽樣而來。

cues.en: Now, in theory, your other bootstrap datasets could be smaller than the original dataset.
cues.zh: 理論上，其他拔靴法資料集可以比原始資料集小。

cues.en: So you know, if this is 10, these could be, you know, five, these could be N equals five.
cues.zh: 例如這裡有 10 筆，那些資料集可以只有 5 筆，也就是 N 等於 5。

cues.en: But it's, you know, it's kind of common when you have a reasonable sized sample dataset.
cues.zh: 不過，當樣本資料集的大小合理時，

cues.en: It's common to have the bootstrap data sets have the same number of elements as the original dataset.
cues.zh: 通常會讓拔靴法資料集的元素數量與原始資料集相同。

cues.en: Now, if your original dataset is really, really large, and you're computing confidence intervals around a parameter estimate that also involves some computation,
cues.zh: 如果原始資料集非常大，而且你要對某個本身也需要計算的參數估計值求信賴區間，

cues.en: then it can become prohibitively expensive, computationally intensive to compute all of these different data sets.
cues.zh: 那麼計算所有這些不同資料集的運算成本，可能高得難以負荷。

cues.en: So, you can have the bootstrap data sets be smaller than the original dataset if your original dataset is really large.
cues.zh: 因此，若原始資料集很大，可以讓拔靴法資料集比原始資料集小。

cues.en: Okay, but anyway, I think you get the idea.
cues.zh: 總之，我想你已經了解概念了。

cues.en: And then what we do with these 500 means, these 500 estimates from these re-sample data sets is compute a distribution.
cues.zh: 接著，我們用這些重抽樣資料集得到的 500 個平均值，也就是 500 個估計值，建立一個分布。

cues.en: And then, we can compare this distribution to the original parameter, and that's gonna be, you know, presumably this will be somewhere at the center of this distribution.
cues.zh: 然後可以把這個分布與原始參數比較；原始參數應該會在分布的中央附近。

cues.en: So now, this is our empirical distribution that we compute the confidence intervals around.
cues.zh: 現在，我們就針對這個經驗分布計算信賴區間。

cues.en: So we say the 95th percentile, so the 2.5th percentile on the bottom or to the left, and the 2.5th percentile of the data,
cues.zh: 我們取 95% 的範圍，也就是下方或左側的 2.5%，以及資料中

cues.en: this bootstrap sample distribution to the right, that gives us our empirical 95% confidence interval.
cues.zh: 這個拔靴法樣本分布右側的 2.5%，便得到經驗性的 95% 信賴區間。

cues.en: So this slide shows the difference between parametric and non-parametric confidence intervals.
cues.zh: 這張投影片呈現參數與無母數信賴區間的差別。

cues.en: This should look familiar from when you learned about permutation testing for T-tests and how to generate a null hypothesis distribution.
cues.zh: 這應該讓你想到之前學過的 t 檢定置換檢定，以及如何產生虛無假設分布。

cues.en: So in that case, we generate the null hypothesis distribution, either from theory, so from a formula or empirically from the data.
cues.zh: 當時我們可以從理論，也就是公式，或直接從資料以經驗方式產生虛無假設分布。

cues.en: So it's a similar concept here.
cues.zh: 這裡的概念也類似。

cues.en: These are not null hypothesis distributions, but it's a similar concept here.
cues.zh: 這些並不是虛無假設分布，但概念相似。

cues.en: With the formula, when we compute confidence intervals based on a formula, we make an assumption about the underlying distribution that it follows a T distribution
cues.zh: 用公式計算信賴區間時，我們假設底層分布服從 t 分布，

cues.en: with N minus one degrees of freedom.
cues.zh: 自由度為 N 減 1。

cues.en: And then, we apply that formula to get these confidence intervals.
cues.zh: 接著套用公式，得到這些信賴區間。

cues.en: And here, with the non-parametric or bootstrapping method of getting confidence intervals, we don't make any assumptions about the underlying shape
cues.zh: 這裡使用無母數方法，也就是拔靴法取得信賴區間時，我們不對底層分布的形狀

cues.en: of the distribution.
cues.zh: 做任何假設。

cues.en: Instead, we sample randomly from our own data in order to empirically generate these confidence intervals.
cues.zh: 我們改成從自己的資料隨機抽樣，以經驗方式產生信賴區間。

cues.en: Okay, so, I hope that distinction is clear.
cues.zh: 好，希望這個區別已經清楚了。

cues.en: Of course, you'll see more of this in the next several videos.
cues.zh: 接下來幾支影片當然還會進一步說明。

cues.en: Now, I'd like to just discuss a bit of the differences between bootstrapping and applying a formula to the parametric approach for confidence intervals.
cues.zh: 現在我想談談拔靴法與套用公式的參數信賴區間方法，有哪些差別。

cues.en: So advantages of bootstrapping are that it works for any kind of parameter.
cues.zh: 拔靴法的優點是適用於任何參數。

cues.en: So I've been discussing this in context of the mean, but you can also get confidence intervals around variance or standard deviation.
cues.zh: 目前我都是以平均值來說明，但你也可以求變異數或標準差的信賴區間。

cues.en: You can get confidence intervals around a correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 你可以求相關係數的信賴區間。

cues.en: You can even get confidence intervals around the median.
cues.zh: 甚至也可以求中位數的信賴區間。

cues.en: And it's also useful when you have a limited data set.
cues.zh: 資料集有限時，它也很有用。

cues.en: So, even in the example I showed in this video that was only an N equals 10.
cues.zh: 例如我在這支影片中示範的例子，N 就只有 10。

cues.en: And a further advantage is that it's not based on any assumptions.
cues.zh: 另一個優點是，它不依賴任何假設。

cues.en: So you don't have to make any particular assumptions about underlying distributions or about the validity of relying on the sample standard deviation
cues.zh: 因此，不需要對底層分布做特定假設，也不需要假定樣本標準差

cues.en: as being the most appropriate measure of dispersion.
cues.zh: 就是最適合的離散程度指標。

cues.en: You just compute the confidence interval based on whatever characteristics are already intrinsically present in the data.
cues.zh: 你只要依據資料本身已經具有的特徵計算信賴區間。

cues.en: So a couple of limitations of the bootstrapping method, it gives slightly different results each time you rerun the analysis.
cues.zh: 拔靴法也有一些限制：每次重新執行分析時，結果會略有不同。

cues.en: You'll see that in the code.
cues.zh: 你會在程式碼中看到。

cues.en: The results generally shouldn't be wildly different each time you run the analysis over and over again.
cues.zh: 一般而言，反覆執行分析時，結果不應該每次都差異非常大。

cues.en: But you know, when you apply a formula, you're always going to get exactly the same result when you do this empirical non-parametric bootstrapping method, the results are gonna change
cues.zh: 不過，套用公式時總是會得到完全相同的結果；使用這種經驗性的無母數拔靴法時，結果會

cues.en: each time you rerun the results.
cues.zh: 隨每次重新執行而改變。

cues.en: Okay, and also, as I mentioned, this bootstrapping method can be time consuming for really large data sets.
cues.zh: 另外，如前所述，資料集非常大時，拔靴法可能很耗時。

cues.en: One way to mitigate this if this is a problem for you, is to have your bootstrapped samples be smaller than the original sample size.
cues.zh: 如果你遇到這個問題，一個減輕方法就是讓拔靴法樣本小於原始樣本大小。

cues.en: And of course, the sample needs to be a good representation of the data.
cues.zh: 當然，樣本必須能妥善代表資料。

cues.en: That's because we are generating the confidence interval based on the data that you've observed.
cues.zh: 因為我們是根據觀察到的資料產生信賴區間。

cues.en: So if the data that you have measured are not a good representative sample, then you're computing confidence interval's based on bad data.
cues.zh: 如果量測的資料不是具有良好代表性的樣本，就是在根據不好的資料計算信賴區間。

cues.en: So you're not going to get a reliable confidence interval, whereas the parametric method is not based on any data.
cues.zh: 所以不會得到可靠的信賴區間；相較之下，參數方法並不以任何資料為依據。

cues.en: So any kind of weird characteristics in your data, maybe there's some outliers in your data that's going to have a smaller effect on the parametric method.
cues.zh: 因此，資料中任何奇怪的特徵，例如某些離群值，對參數方法的影響會比較小。

cues.en: You know, given that it's still based on the sample standard deviation, but weird characteristics of the data can have a bigger negative impact on this non-parametric approach.
cues.zh: 雖然參數方法仍以樣本標準差為依據，但奇怪的資料特徵，可能對這種無母數方法產生更大的負面影響。

cues.en: Okay, so, now you've learned two different methods of computing confidence intervals after getting some traction with this method in code.
cues.zh: 好，你現在已經學會兩種計算信賴區間的方法。等我們透過程式更熟悉這個方法之後，

cues.en: I'm gonna talk more about how to interpret confidence intervals and how to avoid misinterpretations.
cues.zh: 我會進一步說明如何解讀信賴區間，以及如何避免誤解。
